high.title: Luhut Gives Strong Signal That Customs Functions Will Be Taken Over by DSI
high.summary: National Economic Council Chairman Luhut signals major restructuring of customs operations as export duties may be transferred from Customs to new state-owned export company DSI using AI-based digital systems. This represents a significant shift in Indonesia's trade infrastructure and could impact export procedures and government revenue collection.

high.title: Finance Minister Holds Data on 10 Palm Oil Companies Manipulating Exports, Sold Cheaply to Singapore
high.summary: Finance Minister discovers all 10 largest palm oil exporters engaged in under-invoicing, causing estimated $84 million in state losses from just a small sample. This massive export manipulation scandal could lead to major regulatory crackdowns and impact Indonesia's palm oil industry.

high.title: Danantara Responds to S&P and Moody's on One-Door Export Risk Through DSI
high.summary: Rating agencies S&P and Moody's warn that Indonesia's new centralized export policy through DSI could harm export performance, reduce government revenue, and negatively impact investor sentiment. This could affect Indonesia's credit rating and foreign investment flows.

high.title: Luhut on Rupiah and IHSG Bleeding: Indonesia Will Not Collapse
high.summary: Despite rupiah weakness and stock market pressures from capital outflows, economic chief Luhut maintains Indonesia's fundamentals remain strong with low fiscal deficit at 0.93% of GDP. His reassurance comes amid significant market volatility and investor concerns about economic stability.

high.title: FTSE Russell Kicks Out 4 Indonesian Stocks Due to High Shareholding Concentration
high.summary: FTSE Russell removes four Indonesian stocks including DSSA from its Global Equity Index due to high shareholding concentration and insufficient free float. This delisting will trigger foreign selling pressure and negatively impact IHSG performance.

high.title: 27 Countries Queue to Borrow from World Bank Due to Middle East War
high.summary: 27 countries are seeking emergency funding from World Bank following Middle East conflict that began February 28, 2026, with three countries already approved for crisis instruments. This global financial stress could affect international capital flows and emerging market investments including Indonesia.

high.title: IHSG Closed Higher at Start of Week
high.summary: IHSG closed up 0.72% to 6,206.34 points with trading volume of 27.66 billion shares and turnover reaching Rp 16.95 trillion. The positive close provides some relief after recent market pressures from foreign outflows and index rebalancing.

medium.title: 13th Month Salary for Civil Servants Disbursed in June, Here's the Amount
medium.summary: Civil servants will receive 13th month salary starting June 2026 as regulated by Government Regulation No. 9/2026 signed by President Prabowo. This bonus aims to boost purchasing power and contribute to national economic growth.

medium.title: 13th Month Salary for Civil Servant Retirees Disbursed Starting June 2
medium.summary: PT Taspen will distribute 13th month salary to civil servant retirees starting June 2, 2026 through 46 payment partners nationwide without requiring additional procedures. This reflects government appreciation for retiree contributions and ensures welfare continuity.

medium.title: Prabowo's Message to Danantara Managing Rp 17,000 Trillion: Don't Let It Leak, That's People's Money
medium.summary: President Prabowo warns Danantara management to carefully handle state assets worth Rp 17,000 trillion across 1,040 SOEs, emphasizing prevention of fund leakage. This highlights the massive scale of state enterprise assets under centralized management and governance concerns.

medium.title: BEI Welcomes 7 Million New Investors
medium.summary: Indonesia Stock Exchange records 7.4 million new investors from January to May 20, 2026, bringing total to 27.4 million investors. This strong growth shows continued public confidence in capital markets despite recent volatility.

medium.title: Prabowo Agrees to Build Family Office in Bali for World Conglomerate Money
medium.summary: President Prabowo approves establishment of family office around International Financial Center in Bali, with legislation expected to pass June 4, 2026. This initiative aims to attract wealthy global investors and position Indonesia as a regional financial hub.

medium.title: Trade Minister Speaks on Certainty of Trade Tariffs with US
medium.summary: Trade Minister discusses uncertainty over Agreement on Reciprocal Trade with US after Supreme Court cancellation, with temporary 10% tariff for 150 days while US conducts Section 301 investigation. This trade uncertainty could impact Indonesian exporters and bilateral relations.

medium.title: Trade Minister Speaks on Closure of Alfamart and Indomaret in Lombok
medium.summary: Trade Minister explains closures of Alfamart and Indomaret stores in Central Lombok are due to licensing issues related to regional spatial planning compliance. This indicates tighter regulatory enforcement on retail operations in certain regions.

medium.title: Luhut: Customs Needs Reform
medium.summary: National Economic Council Chairman calls for customs system reform using artificial intelligence as new export company DSI is established. This modernization effort aims to improve efficiency in export-import oversight and reporting systems.

medium.title: BCA UMKM Fest 2026 Enlivens Sabang Merauke Pageant at Indonesia Arena
medium.summary: BCA hosts UMKM Fest 2026 supporting micro, small and medium enterprises through collaboration with Sabang Merauke event at Indonesia Arena, August 20-23, 2026. This initiative supports national economy development and UMKM sector growth.
